data.long_meaning: Izmat is derived from the Arabic root 'z-m-t', meaning 'to serve, to make things easier'. It refers to the delicate, precious nature of a person or thing that makes life easier and more beautiful. The name Izmat carries the meaning “Delicacy, Preciousness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Izmat usually hope their child will grow to embody delicacy, preciousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
